summary: --print-command also works for deployments with an explicit external cache
details: --print-command refused CACHE_MODE=lmcache / --cache-mode lmcache given explicitly, which the configurator's generated commands always carry. It now prints such a deployment in its CACHE_MODE=vram form (GPU prefix cache only, same KV size), as it already did for the presets' default external cache, and says so in the script header.
